name: Consolidation Member
description: A company that belongs to a consolidation group, with its ownership share and optional fixed translation rates.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The company's ID in the platform. Pick it from the list on the Consolidation Centre.

fields.label: Ownership %
fields.description: The group's share of this company.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Full: every figure at 100% with the outside share shown separately. Proportionate: every figure at the ownership share.

fields.label: Closing rate
fields.description: Leave 0 to use the company's own exchange-rate table at the end date.

fields.label: Average rate
fields.description: For income and expenses. Leave 0 to use the average of the opening and closing rates.

fields.label: Equity rate
fields.description: For share capital and reserves. Leave 0 to use the closing rate.

fields.label: Opening rate
fields.description: For results of earlier, not yet closed periods. Leave 0 to use the rate at the start date.
